name: Recipe
label: Rezepte

subfolders.description: Cooking: main dishes, soups, side dishes, salads, sauces.
Baking: cakes, bread, rolls, cookies, pastries.
Desserts and sweets that are not baked: puddings, ice cream, creams.
Drinks: cocktails, smoothies, punch, lemonade, coffee and tea recipes.

definition: The image shows a recipe: a list of ingredients and/or preparation steps for a dish, drink or baked good, e.g. a cookbook page, a handwritten recipe card, a screenshot of a recipe website or app, or a recipe post. A photo of food without ingredients or steps is NOT a recipe. Menus, shopping lists and receipts are NOT recipes.
keywordRule: The name of the dish in German, as the recipe names it, e.g. 'Kartoffelsuppe mit Speck'. If there is no title, a short German description of the dish. Translate foreign titles to German only if a common German name exists.
